top_categories.workout_context: 69 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 69 miles.
Base fitness for Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
At Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.

race_overlay.heat: October in Zadar, Croatia can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik’s 69 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Zadar Granfondo Falkensteiner Borik. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 69 miles of mixed terrain in Zadar, Croatia.
